summary: Six text fields showing description, error, required, read-only, disabled and small size.
use: Reference for validation and availability states of a single-line input.
spec: Username has `description="3–20 characters, letters and underscores only."`
Email has `error="Please enter a valid email address."` and `bind:value={wrong}`
Read-only field uses `readonly` and Disabled field uses `disabled`, both `value="Cannot edit this"`
